name: Camp Nejeda
description_short: Sleepaway camp for children with type 1 diabetes on a 72 acre property in Stillwater, in one and two week sessions for ages 7 to 16. Campers do a zip line, climbing wall, low ropes, archery, sports and a daily pool swim, with round the clock nurses and an endocrinologist managing their diabetes care.
special_needs_notes: For children with type 1 diabetes. Nurses are on duty around the clock, a pediatric endocrinologist reviews blood sugars daily and adjusts insulin, and tech facilitators help with pump site and CGM changes. Most counselors have type 1 diabetes. Nut free camp with a dedicated gluten free prep space.

sessions.name: Session 2, two weeks (ages 9 to 13, LIT A)

notes: Prices are Tier 1, the full price. Families choose a tier on an honor system: Tier 2 is $1,475 for one week and $2,900 for two; Tier 3 is a $50 registration fee plus a campership. Camp Nejeda also runs a day camp in West Deptford (outside this region), family camps, a BFF mini camp (August 15 to 17, $450) where a camper brings a friend without diabetes, and a leaders in training program for age 16.
